trust_decision.summary: Whether a .stats file in PYLINT_HOME (from the PYLINTHOME env var or the user cache dir) can be trusted to be deserialized; at the pinned commit it is fed straight to pickle.load in load_results, and the only check (isinstance LinterStats) runs after unpickling.

landing_point.why: The summary names pickle deserialization of the stats cache; caching.py is the only pickle user in pylint/ and load_results holds the pickle.load call.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI `pylint` (Run -> PyLinter.generate_reports at pylint/lint/pylinter.py:1133 and _report_evaluation at pylint/lint/pylinter.py:1157); public API pylint.lint.load_results (pylint/lint/__init__.py:20,40)
CLI `pylint` with persistent=yes (pylint/lint/pylinter.py:1145-1146); public API pylint.lint.save_results (pylint/lint/__init__.py:20,44)
fix_sites.module_kind: cache writer/serializer (same file); fix also corrects ignored pylint_home arg at line 66

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Both changed functions are in pylint/lint/caching.py; the only other unmarshaller, dill.loads at pylint/lint/parallel.py:47, takes in-process bytes from dill.dumps at pylint/lint/parallel.py:142, not disk data.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The writer save_results (pylint/lint/caching.py:57-71) can be argued untouched because 'only loading is dangerous', but then the JSON loader can't read what pickle.dump writes and the previous-run comparison breaks; no sink route exists to dismiss.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Persistent-run comparison: the previous run's stats must still round-trip (global_note 'previous run: X/10', report tables using old_stats), including the set-typed fields modules_names and dependencies; a fix that simply stops loading or returns None breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: cache file containing a pickle payload (old-format/hostile file must not be unpickled, load returns None)
JSON dict rebuilt into LinterStats with set fields modules_names and dependencies values restored from lists
JSON that parses but is not a dict (e.g. int 1) is rejected with the 'old pylint cache' UserWarning

O7_producer.where: pylint/lint/caching.py:57-71 (save_results, pickle.dump at line 69; also writes to the default home ignoring its pylint_home argument at line 66)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A persisted cache of duplicate-code map/reduce data loaded back via pickle from PYLINT_HOME
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Similarity checking is slow and already has map/reduce data structures (get_map_data / reduce_map_data) that a maintainer might cache across runs next to the stats cache.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Workers loading a dill/pickle snapshot of the linter or stats from a file in PYLINT_HOME instead of initargs bytes
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: dill.loads is already used here for linter transfer; spilling to a temp file in the cache dir for large configs is a plausible optimisation, and it sits in another module from caching.py.

O9_family: insecure deserialization (CWE-502, pickle of a cache file in a user-controllable/shared directory)

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -e . (setuptools/pyproject) + pytest; deps astroid, dill, platformdirs

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Keep pickle and add a restricted Unpickler or a post-load isinstance check, or switch only load_results to JSON and leave save_results writing pickle.

out_of_scope_notes: pylint/lint/pylinter.py:1173 eval()s the user-configured 'evaluation' option; config-controlled, not the cache, not pursued.
pylint/lint/utils.py:20 writes crash reports under PYLINT_HOME (write only, no load).

single_site not flagged: the fix touches two functions (load_results, save_results) plus new helpers in one file; it is effectively one sink with no O2/O8, so in practice it is close to single_site.
